translations.literal: Itō strongly demanded all three be granted; Hongzhang only permitted withdrawal, and required mutual withdrawal; Itō also agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Itō demanded all three; Li only agreed to mutual withdrawal, which Itō accepted.

sentences.zh: 吳大澂擬四條，送交伊藤：一，一同撤兵；

translations.literal: Wu Dacheng drafted four articles and sent them to Itō: first, mutual withdrawal of troops;
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dacheng proposed four articles: first, mutual troop withdrawal;

sentences.zh: 二，練兵各營，須有中國教習武弁若干人，定立年限，年滿再行撤回；

translations.literal: second, for training camps, Chinese military instructors must be appointed in certain numbers, with fixed terms, to be withdrawn only when terms expired;
translations.idiomatic: second, Korean training camps must have Chinese instructors for fixed terms;

sentences.zh: 三，以後朝鮮與日本商民爭端，日本派員查辦，不得帶兵，中國亦然；

translations.literal: third, hereafter in disputes between Korea and Japanese merchants, Japan may send officers to investigate but may not bring troops; China likewise;
translations.idiomatic: third, disputes between Korea and Japanese merchants may be investigated without troops by either side;

sentences.zh: 四，朝鮮如有內亂，朝王若請中國派兵，自與日本無涉，事定亦即撤兵，不再留防。

translations.literal: fourth, if there is internal disorder in Korea and the Korean king requests Chinese troops, this has nothing to do with Japan; when settled, troops withdraw immediately and no garrison remains.
translations.idiomatic: fourth, if Korea requests Chinese troops for internal disorder, Japan is not involved; troops withdraw when order is restored.

sentences.zh: 伊藤不以為然，自出所擬條款：一，議定將來中、日兩國永不派兵駐朝；

translations.literal: Itō did not agree and produced his own draft articles: first, agree that China and Japan will never station troops in Korea hereafter;
translations.idiomatic: Itō disagreed and proposed: first, China and Japan will never station troops in Korea;

sentences.zh: 二，前約款仍與中、日兩國戰時之權無干，若他國與朝鮮或有戰爭，或朝鮮有叛亂，亦不在前條之例；

translations.literal: second, previous treaty provisions still do not affect the rights of China and Japan in wartime; if other countries war with Korea, or Korea has rebellion, these are also excepted from the preceding article;
translations.idiomatic: second, prior treaty rights in wartime remain; exceptions for third-party wars or Korean rebellion;

sentences.zh: 三，將來在朝鮮如有中、日兩國交涉，或一國與朝鮮交涉，兩國各派員商辦；

translations.literal: third, hereafter if there are Sino-Japanese dealings in Korea, or one country deals with Korea, each country sends officers to discuss;
translations.idiomatic: third, Sino-Japanese or bilateral dealings with Korea require officers from each side;

sentences.zh: 四，朝鮮教練兵士，宜由朝鮮選他國武弁一員或數員教練；

translations.literal: fourth, Korean military training should be conducted by one or several foreign military instructors chosen by Korea;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, Korean troops should be trained by foreign instructors chosen by Korea;

sentences.zh: 五，兩國駐朝兵，於畫押蓋印後四個月限盡撤。

translations.literal: fifth, troops of both countries in Korea withdraw within four months after signing and sealing.
translations.idiomatic: fifth, both countries' troops withdraw within four months of signing.

sentences.zh: 鴻章以伊藤所擬五條，意在將來彼此永不派兵駐朝，辨駮不允。

translations.literal: Hongzhang held that Itō's five articles aimed at mutual permanent non-stationing of troops in Korea and argued against them.
translations.idiomatic: Li objected that Itō's five articles meant permanent non-stationing of troops.

sentences.zh: 旋奉旨：「撤兵可允，永不派兵不可允；

translations.literal: Soon an imperial edict came: "Withdrawal of troops may be granted; never stationing troops may not be granted;
translations.idiomatic: An edict came: withdrawal may be granted; permanent non-stationing may not;

sentences.zh: 至教練兵士一節，亦須言定兩國均不派員為要。」

translations.literal: as for training troops, it must also be stated that neither country sends officers—this is essential."
translations.idiomatic: neither country may send training officers.

sentences.zh: 鴻章奉旨後，與伊藤會議，因議將前五條改為三條：一，議定兩國撤兵日期；

translations.literal: After receiving the edict, Hongzhang met with Itō and agreed to change the five articles to three: first, set dates for troop withdrawal;
translations.idiomatic: Li met Itō and reduced the five articles to three: withdrawal dates;

sentences.zh: 二，中、日均勿派員在朝教練；

translations.literal: second, neither China nor Japan sends officers to train troops in Korea;
translations.idiomatic: neither side sends training officers to Korea;

sentences.zh: 三，朝鮮若有變亂重大事件，兩國或一國要派兵，應先互行文知照。

translations.literal: third, if major disturbances occur in Korea and one or both countries wish to send troops, written notice must first be exchanged.
translations.idiomatic: major disturbances require prior written notice before sending troops.

sentences.zh: 遂定議，而於議處、償恤仍不許。

translations.literal: Agreement was then reached, but punishment and compensation were still not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Agreement was reached without punishment or compensation.

sentences.zh: 惟因當時日兵實被我軍擊敗傷亡，鴻章因牒日本致惋惜，並自行文戒飭官兵，以明出自己意，與國家不相干涉。

translations.literal: Only because Japanese troops had actually been defeated and suffered casualties, Hongzhang sent a note to Japan expressing regret, and also issued his own document admonishing officers and soldiers, to show this came from his own intent and was not connected with the state.
translations.idiomatic: Because Japanese troops had been defeated, Li sent regret to Japan and admonished his own troops to show this was personal, not state policy.

sentences.zh: 三月初四日，立約畫押，是為中日天津會議專條。

translations.literal: On the fourth day of the third month, the treaty was signed and sealed—this is the Sino-Japanese Tianjin Conference special articles.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day of the third month the treaty was signed—the Tianjin Conference articles.

sentences.zh: 十二年五月，日本公使鹽田議修約，李鴻章以為宜緩，因致總署，謂：「日廷現與歐、美各國改約，應俟彼商定後，我再與議，庶可將西國所訂各款參酌辦理。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twelfth year, Japanese Minister Shioda discussed treaty revision; Li Hongzhang thought it should be delayed and wrote the Yamen: "Japan is now revising treaties with European and American countries; we should wait until they conclude, then negotiate, so Western provisions may be consulted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 12 Minister Shioda sought treaty revision; Li advised delay until Japan finished with Western powers.

sentences.zh: 又球案亦當並商妥結，免致彼此久存芥蒂。

translations.literal: The Ryukyu case should also be settled together, lest mutual grievances linger.
translations.idiomatic: The Ryukyu case should be settled together to avoid lingering grievances.

sentences.zh: 請總署酌奪。」

translations.literal: Please let the Yamen decide."
translations.idiomatic: Please let the Yamen decide."

sentences.zh: 旋因長崎兵捕互鬥案出，暫置未議，而琉球遂屬於日，不復議及矣。

translations.literal: Soon because of the Nagasaki police mutual beating case, discussion was temporarily set aside, and Ryukyu then belonged to Japan, no longer discussed.
translations.idiomatic: The Nagasaki police incident suspended talks, and Ryukyu passed to Japan without further discussion.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月，鹽田因崎案已結，請催修約，總署仍令李鴻章核覆。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirteenth year, Shioda, because the Nagasaki case was concluded, requested urging treaty revision; the Yamen still ordered Li Hongzhang to review and reply.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 13 Shioda, the Nagasaki case settled, urged treaty revision; the Yamen ordered Li to reply.

sentences.zh: 鴻章謂：「原約分修好條規、通商章程為二。

translations.literal: Hongzhang said: "The original treaty divided amity regulations and commercial regulations into two parts.
translations.idiomatic: Li said the treaty divided amity regulations and commercial regulations.

sentences.zh: 條規首段聲明彼此信守，歷久弗渝。

translations.literal: The opening section of the regulations declares mutual observance, unchanged through long years.
translations.idiomatic: The regulations' opening declares mutual observance unchanged through the years.

sentences.zh: 通商章程第三十二款則聲明現定章程十年重修。

translations.literal: Article thirty-two of the commercial regulations declares that the present regulations may be revised after ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Article 32 of the commercial regulations allows revision after ten years.

sentences.zh: 是章程可會商酌改，條規並無可改之說。

translations.literal: Thus the commercial regulations may be discussed and revised; the regulations have no provision for revision.
translations.idiomatic: Commercial regulations may be revised; amity regulations may not.

sentences.zh: 至通商章程，大致本與西約無甚懸殊。

translations.literal: As for the commercial regulations, in general they differ little from Western treaties.
translations.idiomatic: The commercial regulations differ little from Western treaties.

sentences.zh: 惟第十四、五款，不准日人運洋貨入內地、赴內地買土貨，為最要關鍵。

translations.literal: Only articles fourteen and fifteen, forbidding Japanese from shipping foreign goods inland and going inland to buy native goods, are the most crucial.
translations.idiomatic: Articles 14 and 15 forbidding inland trade are the most crucial.

sentences.zh: 當時伊藤與柳原前光為此兩款力爭，鴻章堅持不改。

translations.literal: At that time Itō and Yanagiwara Sakimitsu fought hard over these two articles; Hongzhang firmly refused to change them.
translations.idiomatic: Itō and Yanagiwara had fought hard for these; Li refused to change them.

sentences.zh: 今日稿第一款內，一曰遵守彼國通商章程，再曰遵守清國與各與國所締通商章程，固寓一體均霑之意，實欲將十四、五款刪除，關係甚大，請緩議。」

translations.literal: In the first article of today's draft, one clause says observe their country's commercial regulations, another says observe Qing commercial regulations with all countries—this clearly embodies equal treatment but in fact aims to delete articles fourteen and fifteen; the relation is very great; please defer discussion."
translations.idiomatic: The draft's first article would delete articles 14 and 15 through equal-treatment language; please defer.

sentences.zh: 時日本伊藤博文新秉政，仍欲中國派全權商議，卒不果。

translations.literal: At that time Itō Hirobumi had newly taken power and still wished China to send a plenipotentiary to negotiate; in the end this did not happen.
translations.idiomatic: Itō, newly in power, still wanted a Chinese plenipotentiary; it did not happen.

sentences.zh: 二十年三月，朝鮮東學黨亂作，乞援於中國，中國派兵前往，日本旋亦以兵往。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twentieth year, the Korean Donghak rebellion broke out; they begged aid from China, and China sent troops; Japan soon also sent troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 20 the Donghak rebellion broke out; China sent troops; Japan soon followed.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章電駐日公使汪鳳藻，與日本政府抗議，日仍陸續出兵。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang telegraphed Minister Wang Fengzao in Japan to protest to the Japanese government; Japan still continued sending troops.
translations.idiomatic: Li telegraphed Minister Wang Fengzao to protest; Japan continued sending troops.

sentences.zh: 及事平，駐韓道員袁世凱牒日本駐韓公使大鳥圭介，援約同時撤兵。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, Resident Commissioner in Korea Yuan Shikai notified Japanese Minister in Korea Ōtori Keisuke, citing the treaty to withdraw troops simultaneously.
translations.idiomatic: When settled, Yuan Shikai cited the treaty for simultaneous withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 日本外務省提出三項：一，中、日兩國兵協同平定韓國內亂；

translations.literal: Japan's Foreign Ministry proposed three items: first, Chinese and Japanese troops jointly pacify Korea's internal disorder;
translations.idiomatic: Japan proposed three items: joint pacification of Korea;

sentences.zh: 二，亂定後，兩國各設委員于京城，監督財政及吏治；

translations.literal: second, after disorder is settled, each country establishes commissioners in the capital to supervise finance and administration;
translations.idiomatic: commissioners in Seoul to supervise finance and administration;

sentences.zh: 三，募集公債，以為朝鮮改革經費。

translations.literal: third, raise public bonds for Korean reform expenses.
translations.idiomatic: public bonds for Korean reform.

sentences.zh: 總署電令汪鳳藻答覆，略謂朝鮮內政，應由朝鮮自由改革，不應干預。

translations.literal: The Yamen telegraphed Wang Fengzao to reply that Korean internal affairs should be freely reformed by Korea and should not be interfered with.
translations.idiomatic: The Yamen replied Korea's internal affairs were Korea's own concern.

sentences.zh: 日本政府覆鳳藻，謂朝鮮缺獨立資格，日本為鄰邦交誼，不能不代謀救濟。

translations.literal: The Japanese government replied to Fengzao that Korea lacked qualifications for independence and Japan, as a neighboring country bound by friendship, could not fail to seek relief on its behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Japan replied Korea lacked independence and Japan must aid its neighbor.

sentences.zh: 既又提出二條件，謂無論中國政府贊成提案與否，日本軍隊決不撤回。

translations.literal: They then proposed two further conditions: regardless of whether the Chinese government approved the proposals, Japanese troops would not withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: They added that Japanese troops would not withdraw regardless of China's approval.

sentences.zh: 中國主撤兵再議，日本則要求議定再撤兵，持久不下。

translations.literal: China insisted on withdrawal first then discussion; Japan required agreement first then withdrawal; stalemate persisted.
translations.idiomatic: China wanted withdrawal first; Japan wanted agreement first; deadlock continued.

sentences.zh: 七月，日本遂宣戰，誤擊沈高升英船。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Japan declared war and mistakenly attacked the British ship Kowshing carrying Chinese troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Japan declared war and mistakenly attacked the British ship Kowshing.

sentences.zh: 時日本寓華商民，屬美領事保護，中國寓日商民，亦託美保護，美使調停無效。

translations.literal: At that time Japanese merchants in China were under American consular protection; Chinese merchants in Japan were also under American protection; American mediation failed.
translations.idiomatic: Japanese in China and Chinese in Japan were under American protection; mediation failed.

sentences.zh: 及戰事起，提督葉志超、衛汝貴守平壤牙山，先潰，左寶貴陣亡，海軍繼敗。

translations.literal: When fighting began, Commanders Ye Zhichao and Wei Rugu guarded Pyongyang and Asan and fled first; Zuo Baogui died in battle; the navy was defeated next.
translations.idiomatic: When fighting began, Ye Zhichao and Wei Rugu fled from Pyongyang; Zuo Baogui died; the navy was defeated.

sentences.zh: 於是日軍渡鴨綠江，九連城、鳳凰城、金州、海城、大連、旅順、蓋平、營口、登州次第失守，又破威海衛，襲劉公島，降提督丁汝昌，海軍艦盡熸。

translations.literal: Thereupon Japanese troops crossed the Yalu River; Jiuliancheng, Fenghuangcheng, Jinzhou, Haicheng, Dalian, Lüshun, Gaiping, Yingkou, and Dengzhou fell in succession; Weihaiwei was also taken, Liugong Island attacked, Commander Ding Ruchang surrendered, and the naval fleet was entirely destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Japanese troops crossed the Yalu; city after city fell; Weihaiwei fell, Ding Ruchang surrendered, and the fleet was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 初，日人志在朝鮮，至是並欲中國割地賠費，指索臺灣，又提出四條件：一，派大員往東洋議約；

translations.literal: At first Japan's aim was Korea; by now they also wanted China to cede territory and pay indemnity, demanding Taiwan, and proposed four conditions: first, send a high official to the Eastern Ocean to negotiate a treaty;
translations.idiomatic: Japan's aim expanded from Korea to demanding territory and indemnity, including Taiwan, and four conditions: send a negotiator to Japan;

sentences.zh: 二，賠兵費五萬萬；

translations.literal: second, indemnity of five hundred million taels;
translations.idiomatic: indemnity of 500 million taels;

sentences.zh: 三，割旅順及鳳凰城以東地；

translations.literal: third, cede Lüshun and territory east of Fenghuangcheng;
translations.idiomatic: cede Lüshun and territory east of Fenghuangcheng;

sentences.zh: 四，韓為自主之邦。

translations.literal: fourth, Korea as an autonomous state.
translations.idiomatic: Korea as an autonomous state.

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月，命張廕桓、邵友濂赴日本議和，拒不納，乃再以李鴻章為全權。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-first year, Zhang Yinheng and Shao Youlian were ordered to Japan to negotiate peace; they were refused admission; Li Hongzhang was again appointed plenipotentiary.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 21 Zhang Yinheng and Shao Youlian were sent but refused; Li Hongzhang was appointed plenipotentiary.

sentences.zh: 鴻章至日本，日本派伊藤博文、陸奧宗光為全權大臣，與鴻章會議于馬關，月餘不決。

translations.literal: When Hongzhang reached Japan, Japan appointed Itō Hirobumi and Mutsu Munemitsu as plenipotentiaries; they met with Hongzhang at Shimonoseki for more than a month without resolution.
translations.idiomatic: Li met Itō and Mutsu at Shimonoseki for over a month without resolution.

sentences.zh: 鴻章旋為日本刺客所傷，又命其子李經芳為全權幫辦，卒訂約十一款：認朝鮮獨立，割遼南及臺灣，賠款二萬萬，且許以內地通商、內河行輪、製造土貨等事，暫行停戰。

translations.literal: Hongzhang was soon wounded by a Japanese assassin; his son Li Jingfang was appointed deputy plenipotentiary; they finally concluded eleven articles: recognizing Korean independence, ceding southern Liaodong and Taiwan, indemnity of two hundred million, and permitting inland trade, inland river steam navigation, manufacture of native goods, and other matters, with a temporary ceasefire.
translations.idiomatic: Li was wounded by an assassin; his son Li Jingfang helped conclude eleven articles: Korean independence, cession of southern Liaodong and Taiwan, 200 million indemnity, inland trade and other concessions, with ceasefire.

sentences.zh: 張之洞、劉坤一等聞之，亟電力爭。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong, Liu Kunyi, and others, on hearing this, urgently telegraphed in protest.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong and Liu Kunyi urgently telegraphed in protest.

sentences.zh: 俄國亦約法、德勸日讓還遼南。

translations.literal: Russia also joined France and Germany in urging Japan to return southern Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Russia with France and Germany urged Japan to return southern Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 日索交臺灣益亟，朝旨命臺灣巡撫唐景崧交臺，臺民洶洶欲變，並引公法力爭。

translations.literal: Japan pressed ever more urgently for delivery of Taiwan; the court ordered Taiwan Governor Tang Jingsong to hand over Taiwan; the people of Taiwan were turbulent and nearly rebelled, also invoking international law to protest.
translations.idiomatic: Japan pressed for Taiwan; Tang Jingsong was ordered to hand it over; Taiwanese nearly rebelled and invoked international law.

sentences.zh: 政府不得已，又因王文韶、劉坤一電阻，乃諭之曰：「新定和約，讓地兩處，賠款二萬萬，日人堅執非此不能罷兵。

translations.literal: The government was compelled, and because Wang Wenshao and Liu Kunyi telegraphed to obstruct, instructed them: "The newly settled peace treaty cedes two territories and two hundred million in indemnity; Japan insists it cannot cease hostilities otherwise.
translations.idiomatic: The government, pressed by Wang Wenshao and Liu Kunyi's telegrams, said the treaty ceded two territories and 200 million and Japan would not stop otherwise.

sentences.zh: 連日廷臣來奏，皆以和約為必不可准。

translations.literal: For days court ministers memorialized that the treaty absolutely could not be approved.
translations.idiomatic: Court ministers said the treaty could not be approved.

sentences.zh: 目前事機至迫，和戰兩事，利害攸關，即應主斷。」

translations.literal: The situation is now extremely urgent; peace and war both have consequences; a decision must be made."
translations.idiomatic: The situation is urgent; peace and war both have consequences; decide.

sentences.zh: 命直陳。

translations.literal: They were ordered to state plainly.
translations.idiomatic: They were ordered to state plainly."

sentences.zh: 又命李鴻章覆電伊藤展期。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang was again ordered to telegraph Itō for an extension.
translations.idiomatic: Li was ordered to ask Itō for an extension.

sentences.zh: 鴻章以原議批准電知，若改約另議，適速其決裂，請暫行批換。

translations.literal: Hongzhang said the original agreement had been approved by telegram; if the treaty were changed for new discussion, it would hasten rupture; he requested temporary exchange of ratifications.
translations.idiomatic: Li said changing the treaty would hasten rupture and requested temporary ratification exchange.

sentences.zh: 乃派道員伍廷芳、聯元等往煙臺換約。

translations.literal: Commissioners Wu Tingfang and Lian Yuan were then sent to Yantai to exchange ratifications.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Tingfang and Lian Yuan were sent to Yantai to exchange ratifications.

sentences.zh: 初限期四月十四日。

translations.literal: The original deadline was the fourteenth day of the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: The deadline was the fourteenth day of the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 及伍廷芳等至煙臺，日使伊東美久治請速換約，限十四日申刻。

translations.literal: When Wu Tingfang and others reached Yantai, Japanese Minister Itō Yoshimasa requested rapid exchange, limiting it to the afternoon of the fourteenth.
translations.idiomatic: At Yantai, Minister Itō Yoshimasa requested exchange by the afternoon of the fourteenth.

sentences.zh: 廷芳駮以停戰至十四夜子刻為止，乃聽稍緩。

translations.literal: Tingfang rebutted that the ceasefire lasted until midnight of the fourteenth; only then was a slight delay permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Wu rebutted that the ceasefire lasted until midnight of the fourteenth; a slight delay was granted.

sentences.zh: 亥刻換訖，伊東美久治即行。

translations.literal: At the hai hour ratifications were exchanged; Itō Yoshimasa then departed.
translations.idiomatic: Ratifications were exchanged at the hai hour; Itō Yoshimasa then departed.

sentences.zh: 會臺灣民變，將劫唐景崧、劉永福守臺，別求各國查照公法，從公剖斷。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Taiwan's people rebelled, intending to seize Tang Jingsong and Liu Yongfu who defended Taiwan, and separately sought various countries to examine international law and adjudicate impartially.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan rebelled, threatening Tang Jingsong and Liu Yongfu, and sought foreign powers to adjudicate under international law.

sentences.zh: 於是日派水師提督樺山資紀赴臺，限日交割。

translations.literal: Thereupon Japan sent Naval Commander Kabayama Sukenori to Taiwan with a deadline for handover.
translations.idiomatic: Japan sent Naval Commander Kabayama to Taiwan with a deadline for handover.

sentences.zh: 政府乃派李經芳為交付臺灣大臣。

translations.literal: The government then appointed Li Jingfang as commissioner for delivering Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingfang was appointed commissioner to deliver Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 經芳之澎湖，與樺山指交於舟次。

translations.literal: When Jingfang reached Penghu, he and Kabayama arranged the handover aboard ship.
translations.idiomatic: At Penghu, Li Jingfang and Kabayama completed the handover aboard ship.

sentences.zh: 自是臺灣屬日矣。

translations.literal: From this Taiwan belonged to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan then passed to Japan.

sentences.zh: 尋議還遼，日派林董為全權，與李鴻章議商，辯論久不決。

translations.literal: Soon negotiations for returning Liaodong were held; Japan sent Hayashi as plenipotentiary to discuss with Li Hongzhang; debate continued long without decision.
translations.idiomatic: Negotiations to return Liaodong followed; Hayashi debated with Li Hongzhang for a long time.

sentences.zh: 嗣定議分為六款：一，還遼南地；

translations.literal: Later agreement was fixed in six articles: first, return of southern Liaodong;
translations.idiomatic: Agreement was fixed in six articles: first, return southern Liaodong;

sentences.zh: 二，償兵費三千萬；

translations.literal: second, indemnity of thirty million taels;
translations.idiomatic: second, indemnity of thirty million taels;

sentences.zh: 三，交款三個月以內撤兵；

translations.literal: third, troops withdraw within three months of payment;
translations.idiomatic: third, withdrawal within three months of payment;

sentences.zh: 四，寬貸日本軍隊占踞之間所有關涉日本之中國臣民；

translations.literal: fourth, pardon Japanese troops' occupation-period treatment of Chinese subjects connected with Japan;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, pardon matters involving Chinese subjects during occupation;

sentences.zh: 五，漢文、日本文遇有解譯不同之處，以英文為憑；

translations.literal: fifth, where Chinese and Japanese texts differ in interpretation, English governs;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, English governs textual discrepancies;

sentences.zh: 六，兩國批准自署名蓋印之日起，遂在北京互換。

translations.literal: sixth, after approval by both countries from the date of signature and seal, exchange in Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: sixth, exchange in Beijing after approval.

sentences.zh: 復訂專條，於定議五日內互相達知，以期迅速。

translations.literal: A special article was also concluded, with mutual notification within five days of agreement, for speed.
translations.idiomatic: A special article required mutual notification within five days.

sentences.zh: 是為中日遼南條約。

translations.literal: This is the Sino-Japanese Liaodong treaty.
translations.idiomatic: This was the Liaodong treaty.

sentences.zh: 先是中日新約第六款所列各條，如蘇州、杭州、重慶、沙市等處添設口岸，聽其任便往來；

translations.literal: Earlier, the various articles listed in article six of the new Sino-Japanese treaty, such as adding ports at Suzhou, Hangzhou, Chongqing, and Shashi with free passage;
translations.idiomatic: Article 6 of the new treaty added ports at Suzhou, Hangzhou, Chongqing, and Shashi with free passage;

sentences.zh: 第二條，日本輪船得駛入各口搭客運貨；

translations.literal: article two, Japanese steamers may enter various ports to carry passengers and goods;
translations.idiomatic: article 2 allowed Japanese steamers into various ports;

sentences.zh: 第三條，日本臣民得在中國內地購買經工貨件若自生之物；

translations.literal: article three, Japanese subjects may purchase processed goods or self-produced items in the Chinese interior;
translations.idiomatic: article 3 allowed Japanese to purchase processed or self-produced goods inland;

sentences.zh: 第四條，日本臣民得在中國製造各項工藝，又得將各項機器裝運進口，止交進口稅，日本在中國製造一切貨物，即照日本運入中國貨物一體辦理等節：朝廷因損失利權，欲挽救之。

translations.literal: article four, Japanese subjects may manufacture various crafts in China and import various machines paying only import duty; all goods manufactured by Japan in China are treated like goods Japan imports into China: the court, because of lost rights and interests, wished to remedy this.
translations.idiomatic: article 4 allowed inland manufacture and machine import—the court wished to remedy this loss of rights.

sentences.zh: 又值通商行船章程將開議，乃命中外臣工籌議。

translations.literal: As the commercial shipping regulations were about to be negotiated, Chinese and foreign officials were ordered to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: Commercial regulations were about to be negotiated; officials were ordered to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 廖壽豐、譚繼洵、鹿傳霖均有論奏，而張之洞言尤切直，並擬辦法十九條，電總署代奏：「一，寧波口岸並無租界名目，洋商所居地在江北岸，即名曰洋人寄居之地，其巡捕一切，由浙海關道出費雇募洋人充當。

translations.literal: Liao Shoufeng, Tan Jixun, and Lu Chuanlin all memorialized; Zhang Zhidong spoke especially frankly and drafted nineteen measures, telegraphing the Yamen to memorialize on his behalf: "First, Ningbo port has no concession name; where foreign merchants live is on the north bank of the river, called the place where foreigners reside; patrols are hired by the Zhejiang maritime customs intendant with foreign money.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong telegraphed nineteen proposed measures to the Yamen, beginning with Ningbo's non-concession model.

sentences.zh: 今日本新開蘇、杭、沙市三處口岸，系在內地，與海口不同，應照寧波章程，不設租界名目，但指定地段縱橫四至，名為通商場。

translations.literal: Now Japan opens Suzhou, Hangzhou, and Shashi in the interior, different from seaports; the Ningbo regulations should be followed, with no concession name, but designated areas with boundaries called trading zones.
translations.idiomatic: New interior ports should follow Ningbo's model as trading zones without concessions.

sentences.zh: 其地方人民管轄之權，仍歸中國，其巡捕、緝匪、修路一切，俱由地方官出資募人辦理，不准日人自設巡捕，以免侵我轄地之權。

translations.literal: Local jurisdiction remains China's; patrols, bandit suppression, and road repair are funded and staffed by local officials; Japanese may not establish their own patrols, lest our jurisdictional rights be invaded.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese jurisdiction and policing must remain; Japanese may not establish their own patrols.

sentences.zh: 二，製造貨物，自系單指通商口岸而言，華文有含混內地之意，須更正。

translations.literal: Second, manufacturing goods refers solely to treaty ports; the Chinese text ambiguously suggests the interior and must be corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Second, manufacturing applies only to treaty ports; ambiguous inland language must be corrected.

sentences.zh: 『任便』兩字太寬，宜議定限制。

translations.literal: The words 'at will' are too broad and limits should be negotiated.
translations.idiomatic: 'At will' is too broad and must be limited.

sentences.zh: 三，出示曉諭產貨地方，須先完坐賈釐捐，方准售賣。

translations.literal: Third, proclamations to producing regions require payment of broker taxes before sale is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Third, broker taxes must be paid before goods may be sold.

sentences.zh: 無論洋商、華商，一律辦理。

translations.literal: Foreign and Chinese merchants alike.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign and Chinese merchants alike.

sentences.zh: 日本人在內地購買土貨，只可暫行租棧存放，不准自行開行，及自向散戶收買，以免奪我產貨地方坐賈釐稅，且杜華商影射洋票漏釐。

translations.literal: Japanese purchasing native goods inland may only rent warehouses temporarily; they may not open firms or buy from scattered households, lest broker taxes be lost and Chinese merchants evade taxes under foreign cover.
translations.idiomatic: Japanese inland purchases may use temporary warehouses only, not firms or direct buying from households.

sentences.zh: 四，內地收買土貨，准其租棧暫存，不准購買房地、懸掛招牌。

translations.literal: Fourth, inland purchase of native goods permits temporary warehouse rental, not land purchase or hanging signs.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, no land purchase or signs for inland trade warehouses.

sentences.zh: 所買土貨，務須運載出口，不得在內地轉售。

translations.literal: Purchased native goods must be exported and may not be resold inland.
translations.idiomatic: Purchased goods must be exported, not resold inland.

sentences.zh: 洋貨運入內地，須大宗販賣，不准零售。

translations.literal: Foreign goods entering the interior require bulk sale; retail is not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign goods inland require bulk sale, not retail.

sentences.zh: 租棧應給地方公舉費用，須照華民房屋一律攤派。

translations.literal: Warehouse rent should pay local public fees like Chinese houses.
translations.idiomatic: Warehouse rent should pay local fees like Chinese properties.

sentences.zh: 五，日本人在內地製造土貨，出廠後即完正稅一道，運出通商地界，無論行銷內地及運出外洋，均須再完半稅一道。

translations.literal: Fifth, Japanese manufactured native goods pay full tax on leaving the factory; beyond the treaty zone, whether sold inland or exported, half tax is paid again.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, manufactured goods pay full tax leaving the factory and half tax beyond the treaty zone.

sentences.zh: 六，通商章程善後條約第二款所載各項器用食物進口，通商各口皆准免稅，原為洋商在各口岸自用。

translations.literal: Sixth, article two of the commercial regulations' supplementary treaty lists utensils and food imported tax-free at all ports for foreign merchants' own use.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, tax-free imports are for foreign merchants' own use only.

sentences.zh: 若作貨物轉售，應照值百抽五納稅，不得藉口家用雜物蒙混免稅。

translations.literal: If resold as goods, five percent tax applies; household goods may not be used to evade tax.
translations.idiomatic: Resale requires five percent tax; household-goods evasion is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 七，日本輪船不准販運食鹽。

translations.literal: Seventh, Japanese ships may not transport salt.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, no Japanese salt transport.

sentences.zh: 八，米穀、銅錢不准販運出洋。

translations.literal: Eighth, rice and copper cash may not be exported.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth, no rice or copper cash export.

sentences.zh: 九，軍火禁販，非有官買執照，不准進口。

translations.literal: Ninth, arms are prohibited without official purchase licenses.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth, arms require official licenses.

sentences.zh: 十，日本輪船不准拖帶民船，免致影射漏釐。

translations.literal: Tenth, Japanese ships may not tow Chinese ships lest tax evasion result.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth, no towing Chinese ships to evade taxes.

sentences.zh: 十一，日本行內河輪船，尺寸大小、時刻早晚，須有限制，以免傷礙民船。

translations.literal: Eleventh, inland steamers' size and schedules must be limited lest Chinese boats suffer.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh, inland steamers need size and schedule limits.

sentences.zh: 十二，日本輪船只准到指定口岸裝卸人貨，不准沿途起卸搭載。

translations.literal: Twelfth, Japanese ships may load and unload only at designated ports, not along the route.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth, loading only at designated ports.

sentences.zh: 十三，內河輪船應收船鈔，須較長江加多，以備修理河道之費。

translations.literal: Thirteenth, inland steamer tolls should exceed Yangtze rates for channel repair.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth, inland tolls should exceed Yangtze rates for repairs.

sentences.zh: 十四，日本人入內地辦貨賣貨，不准薙髮改為華裝，違者查出即作華人照奸細治罪。

translations.literal: Fourteenth, Japanese inland traders may not shave heads and wear Chinese dress; violators treated as Chinese spies.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth, no Chinese dress for Japanese traders; violators treated as spies.

sentences.zh: 十五，雇用華民工作，須按日給值，聽其自原，不得立約限期，抑勒作工，鞭撻虐待。

translations.literal: Fifteenth, hiring Chinese workers requires daily wages by agreement; no bonded labor, whipping, or abuse.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteenth, daily wages for Chinese workers; no bonded labor or abuse.

sentences.zh: 十六，裝運機器，製造各物，須無傷民命，方能照準，不得以『任便』兩字藉口。

translations.literal: Sixteenth, machines and manufactures must not endanger lives; 'at will' may not be cited.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteenth, machines must not endanger lives.

sentences.zh: 十七，船隻非日本商人購置，行戶藉日本商資本不得懸掛日本旗，若有冒名包庇，查出即行充公。

translations.literal: Seventeenth, non-Japanese-owned ships may not fly Japanese flags; false use forfeits the ship.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeenth, only Japanese-owned ships may fly Japanese flags.

sentences.zh: 十八，製造各廠，如有藏匿犯法華人，一面由地方官知照領事，一面即派人到廠緝拏，廠主不得袒庇。

translations.literal: Eighteenth, factories harboring criminal Chinese: local officials notify consuls and may arrest; owners may not shield.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteenth, factories harboring criminals may be entered; owners may not shield.

sentences.zh: 如廠主確知為好人，須照洋例存銀作保，到審訊日交出候審。

translations.literal: If the owner knows the person is innocent, deposit silver as bond per foreign practice until trial.
translations.idiomatic: Innocent suspects require bond per foreign practice.

sentences.zh: 十九，廠內如有華工滋鬧，毀傷機器廠屋，地方官只能辦犯，不能賠償。

translations.literal: Nineteenth, factory labor disputes damaging property: officials punish offenders only, no compensation.
translations.idiomatic: Nineteenth, officials punish offenders in labor riots but do not compensate.

sentences.zh: 若僅罷工細故，應由廠主自行調停，官不與聞。」

translations.literal: Minor strikes are settled by owners; officials do not intervene."
translations.idiomatic: Minor strikes are for owners to settle."

sentences.zh: 於是派張廕桓為全權大臣，與日本使臣林董議商約。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zhang Yinheng was appointed plenipotentiary to negotiate the commercial treaty with Japanese Minister Hayashi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yinheng was appointed to negotiate with Minister Hayashi.

sentences.zh: 林董交約稿四十款，之洞致總署請駮辯，即由全權另擬約本與林董議，屢延不決。

translations.literal: Hayashi submitted a forty-article draft; Zhidong wrote the Yamen to rebut; the plenipotentiary drafted another version; debate dragged on.
translations.idiomatic: Hayashi submitted forty articles; Zhang Zhidong urged rebuttal; negotiations dragged on.

sentences.zh: 是年開蘇州商埠，日人欲即行船，總署以租界未定，稅關未設，行船不便。

translations.literal: That year Suzhou port opened; Japan wished immediate shipping; the Yamen said the concession was unsettled and customs unestablished.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou opened; Japan wanted immediate shipping; the Yamen deferred until the concession and customs were ready.

sentences.zh: 日本又欲于租界設巡捕、立工程等局，總署援寧波章程，復不允。

translations.literal: Japan also wished police and engineering bureaus in the concession; the Yamen cited Ningbo and refused.
translations.idiomatic: Japan wanted concession police and engineering bureaus; the Yamen refused citing Ningbo.

sentences.zh: 二十二年正月，商約開議，張廕桓將日使原稿駮刪九款，駮改七款。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-second year commercial talks opened; Zhang Yinheng deleted nine articles and revised seven from the Japanese draft.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 Zhang Yinheng deleted nine and revised seven articles.

sentences.zh: 惟第三十四款，日本官商財產，遇有辦理案件，均照相待最優之國一律；

translations.literal: Only articles thirty-four through thirty-six, on most-favored-nation treatment for Japanese property and persons:
translations.idiomatic: Articles 34-36 on most-favored-nation treatment:

sentences.zh: 第三十五款，日本商民所有事件，均照中國臣民、中國船、中國貨並相待最優之國臣民、船貨一律相待；

translations.literal: Japanese property cases treated like the most favored nation;
translations.idiomatic: Japanese cases treated like the most favored nation;

sentences.zh: 第三十六款，他國國家官員、船貨、人民得有利益，日本一律同獲其美：此三款日本舊約皆不得與各國均霑，不能過拒，乃照英約第二十四款，改作一條，刪此三款。

translations.literal: Japanese benefits equal to other nations: the old treaty did not grant equal treatment; unable to refuse entirely, they followed the British treaty article twenty-four as one article and deleted these three.
translations.idiomatic: Following the British treaty model, these three articles were merged into one.

sentences.zh: 遂定議。

translations.literal: Agreement was then reached.
translations.idiomatic: Agreement was reached.

sentences.zh: 初，馬關約准開四口，本有均照向開海口及內地鎮市章程辦理之言。

translations.literal: At first the Shimonoseki treaty permitted four ports with language following existing seaports and inland market regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Shimonoseki treaty referenced existing port and market regulations.

sentences.zh: 中國欲以寧波辦法為程，日本欲取法上海章程專管租界之條，乃不得不允矣。

translations.literal: China wished the Ningbo method as standard; Japan wanted Shanghai concession rules; China had to concede.
translations.idiomatic: China wanted Ningbo rules; Japan wanted Shanghai concession rules; China conceded.

sentences.zh: 是年開四口租界。

translations.literal: That year four port concessions opened.
translations.idiomatic: Four port concessions opened that year.

sentences.zh: 初開沙市租界，因地窪下，要中國築堤，中國以與各國通例不符，卻之。

translations.literal: When Shashi concession first opened, the land was low and Japan wanted China to build dikes; China refused as contrary to international practice.
translations.idiomatic: Japan wanted China to build Shashi dikes; China refused.

sentences.zh: 又索漢口城外德國租界起沿江之地長三百丈作租界，中國以所索地在中國興辦鐵路應用限內，不許，惟許在德界千丈以外，偪近鐵路，讓給租界三百丈。

translations.literal: They also sought three hundred zhang along the river from the German concession outside Hankou; China refused as within railway limits; only three hundred zhang beyond the German line near the railway was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Japan sought Hankou riverfront land; China granted only land beyond the German concession near the railway.

sentences.zh: 因聲明兩條入條款：「一，偪近鐵路江岸，日本一年須自築堤岸，以資保障；

translations.literal: Two clauses were added: first, near the railway shore Japan must build dikes within one year;
translations.idiomatic: Clauses required Japan to build dikes within one year;

sentences.zh: 二，所給界內軌道穿過之處，已為鐵路購用，若干方數內，應仍歸鐵路總公司管業，兩不相礙」等語。

translations.literal: second, where tracks cross the granted area, land already purchased for the railway remains under the railway company without conflict.
translations.idiomatic: railway land within the concession remains under the railway company.

sentences.zh: 二十四年三月，日使至總署，請沙市租界未定以前，日商運貨暫免釐金，許之。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-fourth year the Japanese minister asked temporary tax exemption for Japanese goods before Shashi concession was fixed; granted.
translations.idiomatic: Temporary tax exemption was granted before Shashi's concession was fixed.

sentences.zh: 是月僑寓沙市湘人，因與招商局起釁，延燒日本領事館，駐沙日領事永瀧訴於日本公使矢野，要求五事；

translations.literal: That month Hunan residents in Shashi, disputing with the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company, burned the Japanese consulate; Consul Nagasaki complained to Minister Yano with five demands;
translations.idiomatic: Hunan residents burned the Japanese consulate in a dispute with the China Merchants Company; Consul Nagasaki demanded five items;

sentences.zh: 已，復提四條：一，索賠一萬八千兩；

translations.literal: later four more: first, indemnity of eighteen thousand taels;
translations.idiomatic: later four more including eighteen thousand taels indemnity;

sentences.zh: 二，以八萬六千餘兩作沿江堤費，兩國各半；

translations.literal: second, eighty-six thousand taels for river dikes, half each country;
translations.idiomatic: eighty-six thousand taels for dikes, shared;

sentences.zh: 三，專界內道路免價豁租；

translations.literal: third, free roads in the concession;
translations.idiomatic: free concession roads;

sentences.zh: 四，界內租地價酌行核減。

translations.literal: fourth, reduced land rent.
translations.idiomatic: reduced land rent.

sentences.zh: 張之洞即電總署，謂：「一條索賠一萬八千兩一節，擬允給一萬兩。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong telegraphed the Yamen: first, eighteen thousand proposed, ten thousand to be granted;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong proposed ten thousand taels instead of eighteen;

sentences.zh: 第二條以八萬六千餘兩作沿江堤費兩國各半一節，彼此兩益，事屬可行，當照允。

translations.literal: second, shared dike costs acceptable;
translations.idiomatic: shared dike costs acceptable;

sentences.zh: 第三條專界內道路免價豁租一節，其租可免，地價未便不給。

translations.literal: third, rent-free roads acceptable but land price must be paid;
translations.idiomatic: free roads but land price must be paid;

sentences.zh: 第四條界內租地價酌行核減一節，可行，當照允。」

translations.literal: fourth, reduced rent acceptable."
translations.idiomatic: reduced rent acceptable."

sentences.zh: 案旋結。

translations.literal: The case was soon settled.
translations.idiomatic: The case was settled.

sentences.zh: 五月，准中國商民居住日本專界，援德界例也。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Chinese merchants were permitted to live in the Japanese concession, following the German precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese merchants were permitted in the Japanese concession following the German precedent.

sentences.zh: 六月，駐沙日領事請地價減一半，道路溝渠地價認十分之一，許之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Shashi consul requested half land price and one-tenth for roads and ditches; granted.
translations.idiomatic: Half land price and one-tenth for roads were granted.

sentences.zh: 七月，命派學生遊學日本。

translations.literal: In the seventh month students were ordered sent to study in Japan.
translations.idiomatic: Students were ordered sent to study in Japan.

sentences.zh: 十月，日使矢野又請中國南北洋、湖北三處各派武備學生前往肄業。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Minister Yano requested military students from north and south China and Hubei to study in Japan.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Yano requested military students from three regions study in Japan.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春，拳匪起，連戕日本使館書記生杉山彬、德使克林德，各國皆出兵。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-sixth year the Boxers rose, successively killing Japanese legation secretary Sugiyama and German minister von Ketteler; all countries sent troops.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26 the Boxers killed Sugiyama and von Ketteler; all powers sent troops.

sentences.zh: 日本福島正安統兵赴津。

translations.literal: Japan's Fukushima Masayasu led troops to Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: Fukushima Masayasu led Japanese troops to Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 六月，與各國聯軍攻天津城。

translations.literal: In the sixth month allied forces attacked Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month allied forces attacked Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 七月二十日，入京師。

translations.literal: On the twentieth day of the seventh month they entered the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the twentieth of the seventh month they entered Beijing.

sentences.zh: 時政府已特召李鴻章，未至而京師陷，兩宮出狩。

translations.literal: The government had specially summoned Li Hongzhang, who had not arrived when the capital fell and the two sovereigns went on tour.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang was summoned but had not arrived when Beijing fell and the court fled.

sentences.zh: 日本外部電告李鴻章等維持中國善後。

translations.literal: Japan's Foreign Ministry telegraphed Li Hongzhang and others to maintain Chinese postwar arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: Japan telegraphed Li Hongzhang to maintain postwar arrangements.

sentences.zh: 福島正安請速奕劻返京，奕劻遂有全權大臣之命，與李鴻章同議和。

translations.literal: Fukushima Masayasu asked Prince Qing to return quickly to Beijing; Prince Qing received plenipotentiary appointment to negotiate peace with Li Hongzhang.
translations.idiomatic: Fukushima asked Prince Qing return; Prince Qing and Li Hongzhang received plenipotentiary powers.

sentences.zh: 適盛京將軍增祺與俄擅定暫約，日本外部謂公約未定，不應立私約，俄約應歸公議，與英、德同。

translations.literal: When Mukden General Zeng Qi privately concluded a provisional treaty with Russia, Japan's Foreign Ministry said public treaties were unsettled and private treaties should not stand; the Russian treaty should join public discussion with Britain and Germany.
translations.idiomatic: Japan objected to Zeng Qi's private Russian treaty as improper before public treaties were settled.

sentences.zh: 然勸俄訖不應。

translations.literal: Persuasion of Russia availed nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Persuasion of Russia failed.

sentences.zh: 時禍首已懲辦，公約亦定，朝廷因日本使館書記生杉山彬被害，特簡戶部侍郎那桐為專使，赴日本道歉，所得償款四百五十兆，日本應得三千七百九十三萬一千兩，惟以俄不退東三省、俄約不歸公議為言。

translations.literal: When ringleaders were punished and the public treaty set, because legation secretary Sugiyama was killed, Household Vice-Minister Natong was appointed special envoy to apologize to Japan; indemnity was 450 million; Japan's share 37,931,000 taels, citing Russia's non-withdrawal from the three eastern provinces and private treaties.
translations.idiomatic: Natong was sent to apologize; indemnity totaled 450 million; Japan received 37,931,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 二十八年三月，日本領事小田切奉其政府命詣張之洞：一，告阻止俄約情形；

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-eighth year Consul Odagiri on government orders called on Zhang Zhidong: first, report on blocking the Russian treaty;
translations.idiomatic: In year 28 Consul Odagiri reported on blocking the Russian treaty to Zhang Zhidong;

sentences.zh: 二，勸中國收買洋藥；

translations.literal: second, urge China to purchase foreign opium;
translations.idiomatic: urged opium purchase;

sentences.zh: 三，勸江、鄂會奏改東三省官制章程；

translations.literal: third, urge Jiang and Hubei to memorialize reforming the three eastern provinces' official system;
translations.idiomatic: urged reform of Manchuria's official system;

sentences.zh: 四，欲與中國商人合開銀行；

translations.literal: fourth, joint bank with Chinese merchants;
translations.idiomatic: proposed a joint bank;

sentences.zh: 五，欲與招商局合辦推廣江海輪船。

translations.literal: fifth, joint steam navigation with the China Merchants Company.
translations.idiomatic: proposed joint steam navigation.

sentences.zh: 既又談商約三條：一曰美使不原加稅，日本意與美同；

translations.literal: They also discussed three commercial points: the American minister did not want increased taxes; Japan agreed with America;
translations.idiomatic: Commercial points: Japan agreed with America on taxes;

sentences.zh: 二曰長沙、常德開口岸；

translations.literal: open Changsha and Changde;
translations.idiomatic: open Changsha and Changde;

sentences.zh: 三曰米穀出洋。

translations.literal: export rice.
translations.idiomatic: export rice.

sentences.zh: 張之洞分別答辨，並將所言致書商約大臣呂海寰等核議。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong replied separately and wrote Commercial Treaty Minister Lü Haihuan and others for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong replied and referred matters to Lü Haihuan.

sentences.zh: 未幾，日本商稅使日置益、小田切又送新約十款，大抵皆抽稅、免釐、行輪、開埠、居住、合股等特殊利益。

translations.literal: Before long, Japanese commercial tax commissioners Nose Masu and Odagiri sent ten new treaty articles, mostly special benefits on taxation, exemption from likin, steam navigation, opening ports, residence, and joint stock.
translations.idiomatic: Japanese commissioners sent ten new articles seeking tax, likin, shipping, port, residence, and joint-stock privileges.

sentences.zh: 時方議英約，中國只欲于英約已允者照辦，未允者不允。

translations.literal: At that time the British treaty was under discussion; China only wished to grant what the British treaty had allowed and refuse what it had not.
translations.idiomatic: China would grant only what the British treaty allowed.

sentences.zh: 屢議不行。

translations.literal: Repeated discussion failed.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated discussion failed.

sentences.zh: 九月，改派伍廷芳充商約大臣，並派袁世凱會議。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Wu Tingfang was reassigned as commercial treaty minister, with Yuan Shikai to confer.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Tingfang was reassigned as commercial minister with Yuan Shikai.

sentences.zh: 日本於加稅免釐，仍不允如英約加至十二五，僅允值百抽十，並欲將由日本運進中國之煤炭、棉紗及一切棉貨概不加稅，尤與英約相背。

translations.literal: On increased taxes and likin exemption Japan still would not agree to twelve and a half percent like Britain, only ten percent, and wanted coal, cotton yarn, and all cotton goods imported from Japan entirely untaxed—especially contrary to the British treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Japan refused British-level tax increases, demanded ten percent, and wanted Japanese coal and cotton untaxed.

sentences.zh: 中國不允。

translations.literal: China refused.
translations.idiomatic: China refused.

sentences.zh: 惟第三款川江設施拖攬，第四款內港行輪及修補章程，第七款中、日商民合股經營，第八款保護商牌，第九款改定國幣，均為英約所有，允之。

translations.literal: Only article three on Yangtze towing, article four on inland steamers and revised regulations, article seven on Sino-Japanese joint ventures, article eight on trademark protection, and article nine on currency reform—all in the British treaty—were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Articles on Yangtze towing, inland steamers, joint ventures, trademarks, and currency—already in the British treaty—were granted.

sentences.zh: 又于商牌款內議增保護版權一事，內港行輪款後議增照會聲明，往來東三省輪船亦系照內港章程辦理，不能駮拒。

translations.literal: Copyright protection was added to the trademark article; inland steamer notes stated Manchuria steamers follow inland regulations and could not be refused.
translations.idiomatic: Copyright protection was added; Manchuria steamers were included under inland regulations.

sentences.zh: 此外第五款索開各處口岸，第六款口岸城鎮任便居住，第九款第二節釐飭度量權衡，第十款請運米穀出口，均駮拒不允。

translations.literal: Articles five opening various ports, six free residence in port towns, nine section two on weights and measures, and ten rice export were all refused.
translations.idiomatic: Opening more ports, free residence, weights and measures, and rice export were refused.

sentences.zh: 日使內田康哉赴部晤商，又提出北京開埠、加稅免釐、米穀出口三條，欲在京與張之洞議，餘仍歸滬定。

translations.literal: Minister Uchida Kanzō met at the ministry and proposed opening Beijing, tax increases with likin exemption, and rice export, wishing to discuss with Zhang Zhidong in Beijing while the rest remained in Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Uchida proposed Beijing opening, tax changes, and rice export for discussion in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 時之洞在京，外務部答以不能兩處分議，遂暫停。

translations.literal: Zhidong was in the capital; the Foreign Ministry replied that discussion could not be split between two places; talks paused.
translations.idiomatic: The Foreign Ministry refused split negotiations; talks paused.

sentences.zh: 十月，漢口因議給比利時界增日本租界。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Hankou, when granting Belgium additional concession land, added Japanese concession land.
translations.idiomatic: Hankou added Japanese concession land when granting Belgium more land.

sentences.zh: 初，日本索租界三百方丈，止允給一百方丈，留二百方丈備中國公司之用。

translations.literal: At first Japan sought three hundred square zhang; only one hundred was granted, two hundred reserved for Chinese companies.
translations.idiomatic: Japan sought three hundred zhang; only one hundred was granted.

sentences.zh: 當時日使言明，日界外地如別有餘地讓給他國，日本仍須照原議添索二百方丈。

translations.literal: The Japanese minister then stated that if surplus land outside the Japanese zone were given others, Japan would still claim the original two hundred zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Japan reserved the right to claim two hundred more zhang if surplus land went to others.

sentences.zh: 茲議給比界中僅餘地約三百丈，擬添給日本租界一百五十丈，仍畫留約一百五十丈立作華業公司地界，以備中國官商自用。

translations.literal: In the Belgian grant only about three hundred zhang remained; one hundred fifty zhang more for Japan was proposed, one hundred fifty reserved for Chinese companies.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred fifty zhang more was proposed for Japan, one hundred fifty reserved for Chinese use.

sentences.zh: 日本猶爭不許。

translations.literal: Japan still contested and would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Japan still objected.

sentences.zh: 日本議設兩湖輪船公司，欲華洋合股，不果。

translations.literal: Japan proposed a Hunan-Hubei steam company with Chinese-foreign joint stock; it failed.
translations.idiomatic: A joint Hunan-Hubei steam company failed.

sentences.zh: 是月，撤駐滬日兵。

translations.literal: That month Japanese troops in Shanghai withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Japanese troops withdrew from Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 尋復議約。

translations.literal: Soon treaty talks resumed.
translations.idiomatic: Treaty talks resumed.

sentences.zh: 日使內田康哉與張之洞在京會議，研商數月，始漸就緒。

translations.literal: Minister Uchida and Zhang Zhidong met in Beijing for months until matters gradually settled.
translations.idiomatic: Uchida and Zhang Zhidong negotiated in Beijing for months.

sentences.zh: 即致總署，謂我所索允者三事：一，照各國一律加稅；

translations.literal: They reported to the Yamen that three requests were granted: first, tax increase equal to other countries;
translations.idiomatic: Three requests were granted: equal tax increases;

sentences.zh: 一，查禁違礙書報；

translations.literal: second, prohibition of objectionable books and newspapers;
translations.idiomatic: prohibition of objectionable publications;

sentences.zh: 一，中國人民在日本者，極力優待。

translations.literal: third, Chinese in Japan treated with utmost favor.
translations.idiomatic: favorable treatment of Chinese in Japan.

sentences.zh: 駮辯刪去者三事：一，請運米穀出口；

translations.literal: Three deleted: rice export;
translations.idiomatic: Three were refused: rice export;

sentences.zh: 一，口岸城鎮任便居住；

translations.literal: free residence in port towns;
translations.idiomatic: free residence in port towns;

sentences.zh: 一，常德府等九處口岸。

translations.literal: nine ports including Changde.
translations.idiomatic: nine ports including Changde.

sentences.zh: 以要索為抵制者一事：各國護路護館兵隊全撤後，北京方能開埠。

translations.literal: One demand used as leverage: Beijing could open only after all countries' railway and legation guards withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing opening was conditioned on withdrawal of all foreign guards.

sentences.zh: 因有益於中國商民，可除積弊，而許其入約者，度量權衡一款；

translations.literal: Granted because it benefited Chinese merchants and removed abuses: weights and measures;
translations.idiomatic: Weights and measures were granted as beneficial reforms;

sentences.zh: 照滬議原文增改字句者，改定國幣一款，內港行輪一款，川江設施拖攬一款；

translations.literal: revised per Shanghai text: currency, inland steamers, Yangtze towing;
translations.idiomatic: currency, inland steamers, and Yangtze towing followed Shanghai text;

sentences.zh: 因英已有而許其入約定議者，長沙通商一款。

translations.literal: because Britain already had it: Changsha trade.
translations.idiomatic: Changsha trade followed the British precedent.

sentences.zh: 餘皆仍照滬議原文。

translations.literal: The rest followed Shanghai text.
translations.idiomatic: The rest followed Shanghai text.

sentences.zh: 又致外務部及呂海寰等，謂日約東三省開埠，言明悉照美約文法，惟安東縣改大東溝，緣大東溝系日本原議所索。

translations.literal: They also wrote the Foreign Ministry and Lü Haihuan that Manchuria ports followed American treaty wording, except Andong changed to Dadonggou as Japan originally requested.
translations.idiomatic: Manchuria ports followed American wording except Andong became Dadonggou.

sentences.zh: 嗣增索安東縣，再三商駮，內田始允仍將安東縣刪去。

translations.literal: Japan later demanded Andong again; after repeated debate Uchida agreed to delete Andong.
translations.idiomatic: Japan later demanded Andong again; Uchida finally agreed to delete it.

sentences.zh: 遂定議，於二十九年八月十八日在滬畫押，是為日本商約。

translations.literal: Agreement was reached; signed in Shanghai on the eighteenth day of the eighth month of the twenty-ninth year—the Japanese commercial treaty.
translations.idiomatic: The Japanese commercial treaty was signed in Shanghai in the eighth month of year 29.

sentences.zh: 是年與日使議索還前借漢口大阪馬頭，仍未還。

translations.literal: That year negotiations to recover the previously loaned Hankou Osaka wharf failed.
translations.idiomatic: Negotiations to recover the Hankou Osaka wharf failed.

sentences.zh: 又盛宣懷與日本立漢冶礦石借款合同，數三百萬元，息六釐，預定三十年還清，不還現銀，以礦價扣還。

translations.literal: Sheng Xuanhuai also concluded a Hanyang iron ore loan contract with Japan for three million yuan at six percent, thirty years to repay in ore value not cash.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Xuanhuai borrowed three million yuan from Japan for Hanyang iron ore, repayable in ore over thirty years.

sentences.zh: 三十年，日商三井在漢廠購生鐵一萬六千頓，值日俄戰起，中國慮于局外中立有礙，擬阻止。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year Mitsui in Hankou purchased sixteen thousand tons of pig iron; as the Russo-Japanese War began China feared neutrality issues and planned to block it.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30 Mitsui purchased sixteen thousand tons of pig iron; China feared neutrality issues.

sentences.zh: 會日本領事永瀧來函，謂訂運生鐵，不在戰時禁貨之列，日使亦來函聲明，作為商工製造之用，不得以禁貨論，遂許運。

translations.literal: Consul Nagasaki wrote that contracted iron transport was not wartime contraband; the minister also stated it was for manufacture not contraband; transport was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Japan argued the iron was not contraband; transport was permitted.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，日戰勝俄，兩國議和，政府令外務部照會日、俄，謂關涉中國之事，若中國不與聞者，中國將來斷不承認。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year Japan defeated Russia; during peace talks the government ordered the Foreign Ministry to notify Japan and Russia that China would not recognize matters affecting China without consultation.
translations.idiomatic: After Japan defeated Russia, China notified both powers it would not recognize matters affecting China without consultation.

sentences.zh: 是年十一月二十六日，外務部慶親王奕劻與日本大使小村壽太郎、公使內田康哉訂新約。

translations.literal: On the twenty-sixth day of the eleventh month of that year Prince Qing Yikuang of the Foreign Ministry signed a new treaty with Ambassador Komura Jutarō and Minister Uchida.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qing signed a new treaty with Komura and Uchida.

sentences.zh: 正約三款：一，凡俄國允讓之利益，中政府悉承諾之；

translations.literal: Main treaty three articles: first, all benefits Russia yielded, China undertakes;
translations.idiomatic: Article 1: China undertakes all benefits Russia yielded;

sentences.zh: 二，凡中、俄所訂借地造路等項，日本悉照約履行；

translations.literal: second, all Sino-Russian leases and railways, Japan performs per treaty;
translations.idiomatic: Article 2: Japan performs Sino-Russian leases and railways per treaty;

sentences.zh: 三，此約簽字即便施行。

translations.literal: third, effective upon signature.
translations.idiomatic: Article 3: effective upon signature.

sentences.zh: 附約十二款：一，中國將東三省自行開闢商埠；

translations.literal: Supplementary twelve articles: first, China opens Manchuria ports itself;
translations.idiomatic: Supplementary articles: China opens Manchuria ports;

sentences.zh: 二、三，撤兵事宜；

translations.literal: second and third, troop withdrawal;
translations.idiomatic: troop withdrawal;

sentences.zh: 四，日本允將所占公私產業，在撤兵前後交還；

translations.literal: fourth, Japan returns public and private property before and after withdrawal;
translations.idiomatic: return of property;

sentences.zh: 六、七、八，安奉、南滿鐵道建築事宜；

translations.literal: sixth through eighth, Anfeng and South Manchuria railway construction;
translations.idiomatic: Anfeng and South Manchuria railways;

sentences.zh: 九，另訂奉天日本租界辦法；

translations.literal: ninth, separate regulations for Japanese concession in Fengtian;
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian Japanese concession regulations;

sentences.zh: 十，鴨綠江右岸設中日木植公司；

translations.literal: tenth, Sino-Japanese timber company on the Yalu's right bank;
translations.idiomatic: Yalu timber company;

sentences.zh: 十一、十二，中、日彼此以最優國相待遇。

translations.literal: eleventh and twelfth, most-favored-nation treatment.
translations.idiomatic: most-favored-nation treatment.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，日人設立南滿洲鐵道株式會社，並於關東州置都督府，另設領事五人，總領事駐奉天。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year Japan established the South Manchuria Railway Company and a governor-general's office in Guandong, with five consuls, chief consul at Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Japan established the South Manchuria Railway Company and Guandong administration with consuls at Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 安奉鐵道外有間島領土權，撫順炭坑、新法鐵道、營口支線、新奉、吉長兩鐵道借款諸事，經東三省總督趙爾巽、徐世昌及外務部尚書袁世凱先後與日使爭議，久不決。

translations.literal: Beyond the Anfeng railway were Jiandao territorial rights, Fushun coal mines, Xinfa railway, Yingkou branch, Xin-Feng and Ji-Chang railway loans—Governors-General Zhao Erxun and Xu Shichang and Foreign Minister Yuan Shikai disputed with Japanese ministers for a long time without resolution.
translations.idiomatic: Fushun coal, Xinfa, Yingkou branch, and Ji-Chang railways were disputed for years.

sentences.zh: 三十三年三月，外務部大臣那桐與日本駐京公使林權助訂中日新奉吉長鐵路協約七條：一、二，中國以日金一百六十六萬元收買日本所已造之新奉鐵路，其續造遼河以東一段及自造吉長鐵路需款，均向南滿洲公司籌借半款。

translations.literal: In the third month of the thirty-third year Foreign Minister Natong and Minister Hayashi signed seven articles on Xin-Feng and Ji-Chang railways: first and second, China pays 1.66 million yen for Japan's Xin-Feng line and borrows half from the South Manchuria Company for the east-of-Liao section and Ji-Chang.
translations.idiomatic: Natong and Hayashi signed seven articles: China buys Xin-Feng and borrows half from the South Manchuria Company for extensions.

sentences.zh: 三，除還清期限外，均照山海關內外鐵路借款合同辦理。

translations.literal: Third, except repayment term, follow Shanhaiguan railway loan terms.
translations.idiomatic: Terms followed the Shanhaiguan railway loan except repayment.

sentences.zh: 其主要事務，又開列六條：甲，借款還清期限，遼河以東十六年，吉長二十五年，限前不得還清；

translations.literal: Six main points: A, repayment sixteen years east of Liao, twenty-five for Ji-Chang, no early repayment;
translations.idiomatic: Repayment: sixteen years east of Liao, twenty-five for Ji-Chang;

sentences.zh: 乙，借款以鐵路產業及進款作保，未還清以前，不得以此作他項借款之抵保物，中國自行籌款建築他路，與南滿洲公司無涉；

translations.literal: B, railway assets as security; no other loans on them; other Chinese railways unrelated to the company;
translations.idiomatic: Railway assets as security; other Chinese railways unrelated;

sentences.zh: 丙，借款本息，由中國政府作保，到期爽約，應由政府代還，或將產業交公司暫管；

translations.literal: C, government guarantees; default means government repayment or company management;
translations.idiomatic: Government guarantee with management on default;

sentences.zh: 丁，在借款期內，總工程師應用日本人，並添派鐵路日帳房一員；

translations.literal: D, Japanese chief engineer and accountant during the loan period;
translations.idiomatic: Japanese chief engineer and accountant required;

sentences.zh: 戊，如遇軍務、賑務，政府在各路運送兵食，均不給價；

translations.literal: E, free military transport in emergencies;
translations.idiomatic: Free military transport in emergencies;

sentences.zh: 己，各路進款，應存日本國銀行。

translations.literal: F, revenue deposited in Japanese banks.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue deposited in Japanese banks.

sentences.zh: 四，與南滿洲鐵路公司訂立關於遼河以東之借款合同，及吉長鐵路借款合同。

translations.literal: Fourth, loan contracts with the company for east-of-Liao and Ji-Chang.
translations.idiomatic: Loan contracts with the company followed.

sentences.zh: 五，中國奉新、吉長鐵路，均應與南滿洲鐵路聯絡，派員會訂章程。

translations.literal: Fifth, Xin-Feng and Ji-Chang link with South Manchuria Railway; joint regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, railways must link with South Manchuria Railway.

sentences.zh: 六，借款實收價值，照中國最近與他國借款酌定。

translations.literal: Sixth, loan value per recent foreign loans.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, loan value per recent foreign loans.

sentences.zh: 此約結後，日人又要求吉長鐵路延長至延吉廳南境，以與韓國會寧鐵道相聯，且照吉長鐵道例，於南滿鐵道會社借資本之半數築之。

translations.literal: After this Japan demanded Ji-Chang extension to Yanji bordering Korea to link with Wonsan railway, borrowing half from the company as with Ji-Chang; government refused; it remained pending.
translations.idiomatic: Japan demanded Ji-Chang extension to Korea; China refused; pending.

sentences.zh: 政府不允，遂成懸案。

translations.literal: The government refused; it remained a pending case.
translations.idiomatic: Pending.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，日使忽提出安奉鐵道案，要求解決。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year the Japanese minister suddenly raised the Anfeng railway case demanding resolution.
translations.idiomatic: In year 34 Japan demanded resolution of the Anfeng railway.

sentences.zh: 先是滿洲善後協約之附約，允安奉鐵道仍歸日本經營，改為工商業鐵道，規定自此路竣工日起，以十五年為限。

translations.literal: The Manchuria supplementary treaty had allowed Japan to operate Anfeng as an industrial railway for fifteen years from completion.
translations.idiomatic: The supplementary treaty allowed Japan fifteen years' operation of Anfeng.

sentences.zh: 至是復提議。

translations.literal: Now it was raised again.
translations.idiomatic: It was raised again.

sentences.zh: 郵傳部乃派委員與日本委員會勘改良之新路線。

translations.literal: The Post Office sent commissioners with Japanese commissioners to survey the improved route.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese and Japanese commissioners surveyed the route.

sentences.zh: 日政府又要求勘定路線即行收買地基。

translations.literal: Japan also demanded immediate land purchase upon survey.
translations.idiomatic: Japan demanded immediate land purchase.

sentences.zh: 東三省總督錫良祗許按舊線改築，要求日本撤退鐵道守備兵與員警等事，日本不允，令鐵道會社自由起工，海陸皆作警備。

translations.literal: Governor Xiliang only permitted rebuilding on the old line and demanded withdrawal of railway guards; Japan refused and ordered free construction with sea and land security.
translations.idiomatic: Xiliang permitted only the old route and demanded guard withdrawal; Japan refused.

sentences.zh: 乃命錫良會同奉天巡撫程德全與日本奉天總領事締結安奉鐵道協約，此宣統元年七月事也。

translations.literal: Xiliang and Fengtian Governor Cheng Dequan were ordered to conclude the Anfeng agreement with the Fengtian consul-general—in the seventh month of the first year of Xuantong.
translations.idiomatic: The Anfeng agreement was concluded in the seventh month of Xuantong year 1.

sentences.zh: 協約要目如左：一，中國確認前次兩國委員勘定之路線，陳相屯至奉天一段，由兩國再協議決定；

translations.literal: Main points: first, China confirms the surveyed route; Chenxiangtun to Fengtian to be decided by both sides;
translations.idiomatic: China confirmed the surveyed route; Chenxiangtun-Fengtian to be decided;

sentences.zh: 二，軌道與京奉鐵道同樣；

translations.literal: second, tracks same as Jing-Feng railway;
translations.idiomatic: tracks same as Jing-Feng;

sentences.zh: 三，此約調印之當日，即協定購買土地及一切細目；

translations.literal: third, land purchase details agreed on signing day;
translations.idiomatic: land purchase on signing day;

sentences.zh: 四，此約調印之翌日，即行急進工事；

translations.literal: fourth, construction begins next day;
translations.idiomatic: construction begins next day;

sentences.zh: 五，沿鐵道之中國地方官，關於施行工事，應妥為照料。

translations.literal: fifth, Chinese local officials assist construction.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese officials assist construction.

sentences.zh: 未幾，間島之爭議又起。

translations.literal: Soon the Jiandao dispute arose.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Jiandao dispute arose.

sentences.zh: 先是，康熙年間，政府與朝鮮劃定國境，於鴨綠江、圖們江水源之長白山上樹立界碑，規定西以鴨綠江、東以圖們江為兩國國境。

translations.literal: In the Kangxi period China and Korea fixed the border at boundary stones on Changbai Mountain at the sources of the Yalu and Tumen, the Yalu west and Tumen east as the border.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi times the Yalu and Tumen were fixed as the Sino-Korean border from Changbai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 因圖們江中有江通灘，地面不及二千畝，因地居江間，四面環水，故以「間島」呼之。

translations.literal: A sandbar in the Tumen under two thousand mu, surrounded by water, was called Jiandao.
translations.idiomatic: A Tumen sandbar under two thousand mu surrounded by water was called Jiandao.

sentences.zh: 此島向屬吉林，惟皇室以長白山一帶為發祥之地，不許人民移居，因之吉林東部所在人煙稀少，間島愈形荒僻。

translations.literal: It belonged to Jilin; the imperial clan forbade settlement on Changbai, so eastern Jilin was sparsely populated and Jiandao desolate.
translations.idiomatic: It belonged to Jilin; settlement was forbidden on Changbai, leaving Jiandao desolate.

sentences.zh: 同治間，朝鮮鐘城歲饑，其民多渡圖們江移居間島，按年納地租於我國光霽峪經歷署。

translations.literal: In Tongzhi times Zhongcheng in Korea suffered famine; many crossed the Tumen to Jiandao paying annual rent to Guangjiyu.
translations.idiomatic: Koreans crossed to Jiandao in Tongzhi times paying rent to Guangjiyu.

sentences.zh: 光緒初年，朝鮮人忽請免納地租，政府以主權攸關，令朝鮮人退出間島，不果，乃置延吉廳以治之，間島仍准朝鮮人民居住，按納地租。

translations.literal: In early Guangxu Koreans sought rent exemption; the government ordered them out; failed; Yanji subprefecture was established; Koreans remained paying rent.
translations.idiomatic: Koreans sought rent exemption; Yanji was established; Koreans remained paying rent.

sentences.zh: 日俄戰後，日本伊藤統監命齋藤中佐率兵據之。

translations.literal: After the Russo-Japanese War Japanese Resident-General Itō sent Colonel Saitō to occupy it with troops.
translations.idiomatic: After the Russo-Japanese War Itō sent troops to occupy Jiandao.

sentences.zh: 政府與日使交涉，日使謂光霽峪以東為東間島，和龍峪一帶為西間島，系兩國未定之界。

translations.literal: In negotiations the Japanese minister said east of Guangjiyu was East Jiandao and Helongyu was West Jiandao, unsettled border.
translations.idiomatic: Japan claimed East and West Jiandao as unsettled border.

sentences.zh: 且謂長白山上界碑載土門江為界，朝鮮人稱海蘭河為「土門河」，圖們江系豆滿江，非「土門江」，中、韓國境實為海蘭河。

translations.literal: The boundary stone said Tumen River; Koreans called Hailan River Tumen; Tumen was Douman not Tumen; the border was Hailan.
translations.idiomatic: Japan claimed Hailan River was the border, not Tumen.

sentences.zh: 中國以「土門」、「豆滿」、「圖們」均系一音之轉，圖們江北岸界碑矻立，鑿鑿可據。

translations.literal: China held Tumen, Douman, and Tumen were transliterations; boundary stones stood on the north bank.
translations.idiomatic: China held they were the same river with boundary stones on the north bank.

sentences.zh: 且光緒十三年，朝鮮王致北洋大臣書，聲明鴨綠江、豆滿江為兩國境界，是豆滿江即土門江無疑，執不許。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 13 the Korean king wrote the Beiyang minister stating Yalu and Douman as border—Douman is Tumen; refused.
translations.idiomatic: The Korean king had recognized Douman as the border in Guangxu 13; China refused Japan's claim.

sentences.zh: 至是，日使伊集院彥吉與外務部尚書梁敦彥重提舊案，締間島條約：一，中、日兩國協約以圖們江為中、韓兩國國境，其江源地方以界碑為起點，依石乙水為界；

translations.literal: Minister Ijuin Hikokichi and Foreign Minister Liang Dunyan reopened the case and concluded the Jiandao treaty: first, Tumen as Sino-Korean border from boundary stones along Shiyi River;
translations.idiomatic: The Jiandao treaty fixed the Tumen as the border from boundary stones along Shiyi River;

sentences.zh: 二，中國准外國人居住龍井村、局子街、頭道溝、百草溝等處貿易，日本於此等地方得設置領事館；

translations.literal: second, foreigners may trade at Longjingcun and other places; Japan may establish consulates;
translations.idiomatic: foreign trade at Longjingcun with Japanese consulates;

sentences.zh: 三，中國准韓國人民在圖們江北之墾地居住；

translations.literal: third, Koreans may farm north of the Tumen;
translations.idiomatic: Koreans may farm north of the Tumen;

sentences.zh: 四，圖們江墾地之韓人，服從中國法權，歸中國地方官管轄及裁判，中國官吏于此等韓人與中國人一律待遇，所有納稅及其他一切行政上處分，亦同于中國人；

translations.literal: fourth, Korean farmers submit to Chinese law and officials with equal treatment and taxation;
translations.idiomatic: Koreans submit to Chinese law with equal treatment;

sentences.zh: 五，韓人訴訟事件，由中國官吏按中國法律秉公辦理，日本領事或委員可任便到堂聽審，惟人命重案，則須先行知日領事到堂，如中國有不按法律判斷之處，日領事可請覆審；

translations.literal: fifth, Korean lawsuits under Chinese law; Japanese may attend; capital cases require Japanese notice; retrial if unjust;
translations.idiomatic: Korean lawsuits under Chinese law with Japanese attendance;

sentences.zh: 六，圖們江雜居區域內韓人之財產，中國地方官視同中國人民財產，一律保護，該江沿岸，彼此人民得任便往來，惟無護照公文，不得持械過境；

translations.literal: sixth, Korean property equally protected; free crossing without arms without passports;
translations.idiomatic: Korean property protected; crossing without arms requires no passport;

sentences.zh: 七，中國將吉長鐵道延長至延吉南邊界，與朝鮮會寧鐵道聯絡，一切辦理與吉長鐵道同；

translations.literal: seventh, Ji-Chang extended to Yanji border linking Wonsan railway like Ji-Chang;
translations.idiomatic: Ji-Chang extended to Yanji to link Korea's railway;

sentences.zh: 八，本協約調印後，日本統監府派出所及文武人員于兩月內完全撤退。

translations.literal: eighth, Japanese garrison withdraws within two months.
translations.idiomatic: Japanese garrison withdraws within two months.

sentences.zh: 是約既成，政府以吳祿貞為延吉邊務大臣。

translations.literal: Wu Luzhen was appointed Yanji frontier commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Luzhen was appointed Yanji frontier commissioner.

sentences.zh: 嗣議五案協約，即新法鐵道，營口支線，撫順、煙臺炭礦，安奉鐵道沿線及南滿鐵道幹路沿線之礦務是也。

translations.literal: Five-case agreements followed: Xinfa railway, Yingkou branch, Fushun and Yantai coal, mines along Anfeng and South Manchuria trunk lines.
translations.idiomatic: Five agreements followed on railways and mines.

sentences.zh: 新法鐵道者，新民屯至法庫門之鐵道，政府欲借英款築造此路，以分南滿鐵道之勢力，日本謂系南滿鐵道競爭線，極力抗議。

translations.literal: Xinfa railway from Xinmintun to Fakumen: China wanted British loans to counter South Manchuria influence; Japan protested as competing line.
translations.idiomatic: Xinfa railway: China sought British loans; Japan protested as competition.

sentences.zh: 營口支線者，光緒二十五年東清鐵道會社規定築造旅順、哈爾濱間之鐵道，得設營口支線，以運送材料，俟鐵道落成後拆去。

translations.literal: Yingkou branch: in Guangxu 25 the East Qing Railway Company could build a branch for materials, to be removed after completion.
translations.idiomatic: Yingkou branch: originally for construction materials, to be removed after completion.

sentences.zh: 日俄戰爭後，南滿鐵道歸日本，政府要求日本拆此支線，日本不允。

translations.literal: After the Russo-Japanese War the South Manchuria Railway passed to Japan; the government demanded Japan dismantle this branch line; Japan refused.
translations.idiomatic: After the war the government demanded Japan dismantle the Yingkou branch; Japan refused.

sentences.zh: 撫順炭礦，距奉天城東六十里，日公使以此地炭礦為東清鐵道附屬品，利權應歸日本。

translations.literal: Fushun coal mine, sixty li east of Fengtian city: the Japanese minister held this coal mine was an accessory of the East Qing Railway and rights belonged to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: Japan claimed Fushun coal as an East Qing Railway accessory.

sentences.zh: 政府以炭山在東清鐵道三十里外，不認為附屬財產，日使不允；

translations.literal: The government held the coal mountain was over thirty li outside the railway and was not accessory property; the Japanese minister refused;
translations.idiomatic: China held Fushun was over thirty li from the railway and not accessory property; Japan refused;

sentences.zh: 並煙臺炭礦均成懸案。

translations.literal: and Yantai coal mine also remained pending.
translations.idiomatic: Yantai coal also remained pending.

sentences.zh: 因安奉鐵道交涉，定約如下：一，中國如築新法鐵道時，當先與日本商議；

translations.literal: Because of Anfeng railway negotiations, agreement was fixed as follows: first, when China builds the Xinfa railway it must first consult Japan;
translations.idiomatic: Anfeng negotiations agreed: China must consult Japan before building Xinfa railway;

sentences.zh: 二，中國允日本營口支路，俟南滿鐵道期限滿，同時交還，並允將該支線延長至營口新市街；

translations.literal: second, China permits Japan's Yingkou branch; when the South Manchuria Railway term expires it returns simultaneously, and the branch may extend to new Yingkou city;
translations.idiomatic: second, Yingkou branch returns when South Manchuria Railway term expires and may extend to new Yingkou;

sentences.zh: 三，中國承認日本有開採撫順、煙臺兩處炭礦之權，日本承認該兩處開採之煤斤納稅與中國，惟稅率應按照中國他處最輕煤稅之例，另行協定，其礦界及一切章程，亦另委員定之；

translations.literal: third, China recognizes Japan's right to mine Fushun and Yantai coal; Japan recognizes tax payment to China at China's lightest coal tax rate, boundaries and regulations by separate commission;
translations.idiomatic: third, Japan mines Fushun and Yantai paying China's lightest coal tax;

sentences.zh: 四，安奉鐵道沿線及南滿洲鐵道幹路沿線之礦務，除撫順、煙臺外，應按照光緒三十三年東三省督撫與奉天日本總領事議定之大綱，歸中、日合辦；

translations.literal: fourth, mines along Anfeng and South Manchuria trunk lines except Fushun and Yantai follow the Guangxu 33 outline by Manchuria governors and Fengtian consul-general, Sino-Japanese joint operation;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, other mines along those lines are Sino-Japanese joint ventures per the Guangxu 33 outline;

sentences.zh: 五，京奉鐵道沿長至奉天城根一節，日本無異議。

translations.literal: fifth, Japan has no objection to Jing-Feng railway extension to Fengtian city root.
translations.idiomatic: fifth, Japan has no objection to Jing-Feng extension to Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 自此南滿洲大勢遂一變矣。

translations.literal: From this the general situation in southern Manchuria changed entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Manchuria's situation changed entirely.

sentences.zh: 吉長、新奉兩路借款細目，旋亦議定。

translations.literal: Ji-Chang and Xin-Feng loan details were soon settled.
translations.idiomatic: Ji-Chang and Xin-Feng loan details were settled.

sentences.zh: 其後錦齊鐵道、渤海漁權與領海、鴨綠江架橋、南滿鐵道附屬電線、收買日本遼東方面軍用電線及旅順芝罘間海底電線諸交涉，次第起焉。

translations.literal: Thereafter Jinzhan railway, Bohai fisheries and territorial waters, Yalu bridge, South Manchuria subsidiary telegraph lines, purchase of Japanese military telegraph lines in Liaodong and Lüshun-Yantai submarine cable negotiations arose in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Later disputes arose over Jinzhan railway, Bohai fisheries, the Yalu bridge, telegraph lines, and submarine cables.

sentences.zh: 錦齊鐵道者，即自錦州經洮南至齊齊哈爾之鐵道也。

translations.literal: Jinzhan railway runs from Jinzhou through Taonan to Qiqihar.
translations.idiomatic: Jinzhan railway runs from Jinzhou through Taonan to Qiqihar.

sentences.zh: 日本原允中國自修，惟要求昌圖洮南間之鐵道歸日本築造。

translations.literal: Japan originally permitted China to build it itself but demanded the Changtu-Taonan section for Japan.
translations.idiomatic: Japan permitted China to build it but demanded the Changtu-Taonan section.

sentences.zh: 及滿洲諸協約成，英、美爭錦齊鐵道借款，迭與中國交涉，事皆中阻。

translations.literal: After Manchuria agreements, Britain and America competed for Jinzhan loans; repeated negotiations with China were all obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: British and American Jinzhan loan competition obstructed negotiations.

sentences.zh: 渤海漁業與領海交涉，自，中國課關東漁業團漁稅，迭經日本領事要求住關東之日本人有滿洲沿岸漁業權，日本漁團因避稅，全出距海岸三海里外海面。

translations.literal: Bohai fisheries and territorial sea: from when China taxed the Guandong Fishery Association, Japanese consuls repeatedly demanded Japanese in Guandong had Manchurian coast fishing rights; Japanese fleets fished beyond three nautical miles to avoid tax.
translations.idiomatic: China taxed Guandong fisheries; Japan claimed coastal rights and fished beyond three miles to avoid tax.

sentences.zh: 東督錫良通告日本領事，謂三海里外之海面系中國領海，應准中國漁業規則課稅。

translations.literal: Governor Xiliang notified the Japanese consul that beyond three miles was Chinese territorial sea subject to Chinese fishery rules.
translations.idiomatic: Xiliang held waters beyond three miles were Chinese territorial sea.

sentences.zh: 日本領事以三海里外為公海，反抗之。

translations.literal: The Japanese consul held beyond three miles was high seas and resisted.
translations.idiomatic: Japan held beyond three miles was high seas.

sentences.zh: 鴨綠江駕橋，聯絡滿、韓，議定依安奉鐵道契約，十五年後賣還中國。

translations.literal: Yalu bridge linking Manchuria and Korea: per Anfeng agreement, sold back to China after fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: The Yalu bridge would revert to China after fifteen years per the Anfeng agreement.

sentences.zh: 南滿鐵道附屬電線，原中國所設，日本佔有之，後取供公用，中國抗爭無效。

translations.literal: South Manchuria subsidiary telegraph lines originally China's, occupied by Japan for public use; Chinese protest failed.
translations.idiomatic: Japan occupied Chinese telegraph lines; protest failed.

sentences.zh: 又日俄戰爭時，日本在南滿洲所設軍用電線，戰局終，應歸中國收買，日本初起反抗，後始歸中國收買。

translations.literal: Japanese military telegraph lines in South Manchuria during the Russo-Japanese War should be bought by China after the war; Japan initially resisted then permitted purchase.
translations.idiomatic: Japan initially resisted selling military telegraph lines then permitted purchase.

sentences.zh: 旅順芝罘之海底電線，系俄國佈設，戰時皆斷絕。

translations.literal: Lüshun-Yantai submarine cable laid by Russia; both severed in the war.
translations.idiomatic: The Lüshun-Yantai cable laid by Russia was severed in the war.

sentences.zh: 至此，日本要求依該海底電線直通芝罘之日本電線局，為中國所拒。

translations.literal: Japan then demanded connection to Yantai through that cable; China refused.
translations.idiomatic: Japan demanded connection to Yantai; China refused.

sentences.zh: 卒以距芝罘海岸七里半以內之一部歸中國，餘盡屬諸日本。

translations.literal: Finally the section within seven and a half li of Yantai coast went to China; the rest to Japan.
translations.idiomatic: China received the section within seven and a half li of Yantai; the rest went to Japan.

sentences.zh: 其後復有日俄協約之議，於是東三省大勢又一變矣。

translations.literal: Later the Russo-Japanese agreement was discussed; the general situation in the three eastern provinces changed again.
translations.idiomatic: Later Russo-Japanese agreements changed the three eastern provinces again.
